Devkitty 1.0.0 (build 341)

  • Browser: when Devkitty is dark, websites without their own dark mode are darkened automatically. Photos and videos keep their colors.
  • Turn it on or off for a site with the moon button in the URL bar, the page or URL-bar right-click menu, or Cmd+P. Settings > Browser has the main switch and Forget for saved site choices.
  • Sites with their own dark mode are never changed, and nothing changes in light mode.
  • The Dock icon badge also counts tabs where an agent waits for your answer or permission (the orange dot), not only unread notifications.
  • Devkitty turns on macOS badge permission once at launch if notifications were allowed before badges existed.
  • Cmd+Shift+[ and Cmd+Shift+] skip tabs inside a collapsed tab group, like Cmd+1…9; the group stays closed.
